narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Ten divided by five is two, and four divided by four is one. The answer is two.
<bookmark mark='cols'/>But there are four columns, and each column is a ten over a five.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Each column gives its own two, so we cannot stop at one two.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>When the exponents match, divide the bases and keep the same exponent.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Write six to the power three divided by three to the power three as a power. Then check it.
